title: Reporting Allowance on Northgate Protect Food-Loss Payments
content:
A reporting allowance is added to a Northgate Protect Standard-tier food-loss payment by the days from the incident date to the food-loss claim's filing date: the next-day allowance of $10.00 at no more than 1 day, the week allowance of $5.00 at two to 7 days, and nothing later. The days are calendar days between the two dates recorded on the food-loss claim.

| Days from incident date to filing date | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | $10.00 |
| 2 to 7 | $5.00 |
| 8 or more | Nothing |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical dates)

| Incident | Filed | Days | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 September | 4 September | 1 | $10.00 |
| 3 September | 5 September | 2 | $5.00 |
| 3 September | 10 September | 7 | $5.00 |
| 3 September | 11 September | 8 | Nothing |
